name: ANSI/IEEE temperature switch no symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for temperature switch no, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The temperature-operated NO form relates a discrete contact to a specified thermal condition. Sensor placement and rising or falling temperature action need annotations beyond the actuation modifier.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Do not infer alarm direction from the NO contact alone.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A temperature switch is distinct from an RTD or thermocouple measurement input.
